paperPolicy.madeToMeasure: Regenerate all paper instances dependent on changed measurements; rebuild their seams, placement and rest-state bindings.
paperPolicy.fixedSize: Retain explicitly selected garment size and paper identity; re-fit to the new body and do not carry old fit acceptance forward.

invalidationRules.currentR03Behavior: Reject unsupported dynamic-body input; the current static-body path cannot be upgraded by merely invalidating its cache.

invalidationRules.required: Use an explicit, separately validated reinitialization or fail/rollback policy. Never carry stale body velocities or contact history across the discontinuity without checks.

adoptionOrder.work: Read and expose existing identities, capabilities and diagnostics; preserve unknowns.
Add material direction and provenance to two existing materials; calibrate only what is measured.
Close one existing parameter edit through the native generation and diagnostic chain with revision guards.
Consume independently accepted garments using one body finalPose and revalidate contacts.
Attach trims or embroidery to stable material coordinates after macro fit gates.

acceptanceProvenance.reuseRule: Each gate declares its dependency fingerprint and tested scope. A changed dependency marks that result stale for the new candidate; the historical result remains valid only for its original input.
acceptanceProvenance.appearanceOnlyRule: Physical evidence may be reused only when its dependency fingerprint is proven unchanged. Appearance and visible geometry acceptance is reviewed independently.
acceptanceProvenance.unknownDependencyRule: Do not carry an old PASS forward when dependencies are unknown.
